## FirstReply
A new lead (form, Meta Lead Ad, WhatsApp, email) → instant reply to the lead → alert to the owner → logged in the Leads sheet.
Every morning: a digest of who still needs a human follow-up.
Rules live in one place: the Code nodes (source: respond.js). Customize `fromIntake()` for your actual intake source.

### Sample payload
`send-test.sh` posts a generic lead-shaped sample.
To go live: point your form/ad platform’s webhook here (or use its native webhook/Zapier-style integration) with header `X-Intake-Secret`. Capture one real payload and adjust `fromIntake()` only — see docs/intake-mapping.md for five common sources.

### WhatsApp replies
Replying to a lead on WhatsApp before they’ve messaged you first requires a pre-approved message template (Meta’s rule, not this workflow’s). Email replies need no approval, so that’s the reliable default here; swap in an approved WhatsApp template (or Twilio for SMS) the same way CloseLoop swaps its WhatsApp node.

### After hours
The reply to the lead always goes out instantly, any time, any day — that’s the whole point. Only the owner alert gets flagged “needs personal follow-up,” so nothing sits unanswered just because it arrived at 2am.
